# AuroraScript

AuroraScript is a .NET-hosted scripting language distributed by the AuroraScript.JIT NuGet package.
Use these documents when writing, reviewing, or fixing AuroraScript code.

## Core Documents

- [AI reference](docs/aurora-script-ai.md): compact syntax, semantics, runtime APIs, diagnostics, and examples.
- [Script authoring best practices](docs/script-authoring-best-practices.md): recommended defaults for AI-generated modules, CompileBlock bodies, imports, data shapes, and validation.
- [Language reference](docs/language-reference.md): complete language feature reference.
- [Performance best practices](docs/performance-best-practices.md): compiler and runtime optimization guidance.
- [Host integration guide](docs/host-integration.md): .NET host API, custom resolver rules, CLR interop, native host exports, domains, and hot patch usage.

## Machine-Readable Files

- [EBNF grammar](schema/aurora-script.ebnf)
- [Language feature index](schema/language-features.json)
- [Script runtime API index](schema/runtime-api.json)

- [Host API schema](schema/host-api.schema.json)
- [Diagnostics schema](schema/diagnostics.schema.json)
- [AST schema](schema/ast.schema.json)

## MCP

- [AuroraScript MCP server](../language-tools/AuroraScript.Mcp/README.md)

When uncertain, prefer `aurora_check_script` from the MCP server over guessing.
